message.content: The agent confirmed Flask, torch, and transformers were installed, downloaded the distilbert SST-2 model to /app/model_cache/sentiment_model, wrote /app/app.py with a POST /sentiment endpoint, started it in the background on 0.0.0.0:5000, and verified positive/negative results plus 400 errors for missing, non-string, and empty text; the non-JSON body test failed due to a urllib str/bytes bug and remains unverified.
